reviewer: Antigravity Studio Agent (verified against full HyperFrames MP4 render and snapshot contact sheet)

criteria.question: One clear focal point per beat; reading order is obvious.
criteria.notes: Every beat pairs a clear scene header with one hero visual anchor: the rising smartphone trading app in Scene 1, the draining collateral gauge in Scene 2, the plunging order book in Scene 3, and the -$2.4T counter in Scene 4.

criteria.question: Type roles are consistent; sizes respect the floor; no orphans or awkward breaks.
criteria.notes: Oswald for display titles, Inter for subtitles, and IBM Plex Mono for all financial telemetry and HUD markers. All text sizes exceed the 2.6% floor requirement.

criteria.question: Layouts are intentional in every format (not stretched or cropped landscape).
criteria.notes: Engineered natively for 720x1280 9:16 portrait. Top HUD is pinned below the 10% safe area; captions sit above the 20% Instagram Reel bottom control safe zone.

criteria.question: Holds match reading time; rhythm varies; nothing drags or rushes.
criteria.notes: Choreographed to millisecond-accurate Kokoro TTS narration timings. The final -$2.4T resolution card holds for 2.0s with subtle breathing pulse to conclude.

criteria.question: All text is legible at delivery size with sufficient contrast.
criteria.notes: Bright white and glowing neon red (#ff334b) / cyan (#38bdf8) achieve over 8:1 contrast against the obsidian gradient background.

criteria.question: Palette and texture follow the chosen style system and direction.
criteria.notes: Implements cinematic-dark with phosphor CRT scanlines and Bloomberg terminal aesthetic, perfectly matching the approved brief.

criteria.question: Transitions connect thoughts; continuity holds across cuts.
criteria.notes: Cuts and wipes are synchronized to narrative scene boundary timestamps; FFmpeg blackdetect verified zero unintended black screen gaps.

criteria.question: Metaphors, shapes and iconography stay in the same visual universe.
criteria.notes: Consistent financial terminal interface elements: candlestick chart, debt leverage bar, radial collateral gauge, order depth meter, and falling particle waterfall.

criteria.question: Motion explains or reveals; no idle loops for the sake of movement.
criteria.notes: Every tween directly visualizes economic mechanics: leverage multiplication, equity depletion under margin call, and retail order book vacuum.

criteria.question: No stretches where nothing changes and nothing is read.
criteria.notes: Pacing remains active throughout with HUD telemetry updates, progressive curve draws, and particle cascades.

criteria.question: Elements don't clip, overlap awkwardly or fight for attention.
criteria.notes: Clear vertical spacing hierarchy: HUD at top, scene header in upper third, visual stage in center, captions in lower third.

criteria.question: The piece has a clear beginning, middle and end; the payoff lands.
criteria.notes: Four-act psychological drama: Act 1 (Euphoria), Act 2 (The Trap Snaps), Act 3 (The Stampede), and Act 4 (The Broken Spell).
